received_works.body:
Howody! Nanoka and Xuehua dress up for a special occasion... as maids, of course. Cowboy shot would be fine.

Nanoka lifts the hem of her skirt on one side. Perhaps with the other she flashes a V peace sign? Her expression can be a sweet smile. Difference: Nanoka sticks her tongue out mischievously.

Xuehua makes a heart with her hands (framing her navel?). Her expression could be a little troubled (vulnerable?). Difference: bashful Xuehua. You could even draw small tears in the corner of her eyes. Or you could go for narrowed eyes and disdain, lol.

I'm not exactly married to all the small details, so you're welcome to include some artistic liberties. You're the best, thanks 🦐🦐🦐

It's time for us to give Hui Xuehua more love. You remember the dakimakura-style illustration you did of Nanoka? I think a daki-style Xuehua would be very nice, too! The base pose that I'm imagining: Xuehua lays down and stretches indulgently (very feline-like). She is arching her back (placing a bit of emphasis on her her stomach, hourglass figure, and her clavicle). If you'd like to include a secondary pose (for her hands), perhaps you could rest her hands along her clavicle. Or you could go for some type of embarrassed/bashful pose. What expressions do you think would be fun? Yawning, sleepy, and bashful? Perhaps a cute plushie or two would add gap moe (since she's usually quite a tomboy).

If you don't mind making this riku a dress-up like you did with Nanoka, then please consider drawing a few outfits for her. Is there a particular outfit you'd like to draw? Otherwise, her are some ideas:

Jogging/activewear - spats & sportsbra
Oversized hoodie - something comfie she'd wear at home
彼シャツ - both iterations buttoned and unbuttoned

If you have some cool ideas, you're more than welcome to include them, too! Thanks for lending an ear, it's appreciated! 🦐🦐🦐🦐🦐

Sarla-san, the time has come where we give Shiori-chan more love. I have a couple ideas that I'll share. But ultimately I won't try to be too picky on the outcome, lol.

First idea is nurse outfit. It could be from the PoV of a patient, where Shiori has one knee up on the bed and is approaching with a stethoscope or syringe. Nurses ofc look very sexy, but I am a little worried it wouldn't suit Shiori's character well.

Second idea is a pretty sundress. Essentially, it's something she would wear to the beach or lake. Although... it would make the most sense to wear a swimsuit beneath that kind of outfit 💀.

Third idea: aquarium date. It could be flashy and cute, or it could be more like an undercover idol 💖. She could be blowing a kiss or some other cute (idol-like?) pose.

So, it sorta boils down to what you'd like to draw Shiori-chan wearing. I think they all have potential. If anything, I am leaning toward the third idea. It suits her design and personality, we haven't done something like it yet, and it should look quite good, too. What do you think?

Thanks for your time, I appreciate it.

Howdy once more, Sarla-san! Perhaps you'd like to help me design some more original daughters? 😌

Shiori (海): an axolotl girl with strawberry red hair. She would probably look nice with pink eyes. I imagine her ear fins (or whatever they're called lol) are white or a pale pink with red highlights (fringe? whatever you'd call it). She probably has pale skin, but... you don't need to color her paler than you usually do unless you think it'll look nice. I'm imagining her personality as insightful but a bit eccentric. What kind of expressions do you think would be fun? One combo I think could be cute is with star eyes and a :3 mouth, lol. I included two examples of hair in the reference. So... it doesn't have to be precisely like either, but I am imagining her hair (medium or long length) is gathered at the bottom. Perhaps the fringe and bangs are curly? What do you think?

Hui Xuehua (辉雪花): a snow leopard girl with silver hair. She has tanned skin (no swimsuit lines, please). How tan are you comfortable drawing? Nagatoro-dark would be fine, but as long as she looks nice I won't be too picky. She shouldn't quite look Indian or African, though. Rather, it should have a healthy, vibrant feel to it. Perhaps her hair has light blue (or an icy cyan) as a secondary color. It could be highlights, or it could be one of those two-tone things like what Kazusa (from Blue Archive) has. I included an example in the references in case it's necessary. I'm not entirely married to any particular hairstyle for Xuehua. She's half chinese and half tibetan. That said, braids are pretty much the only real traditional tibetan style. I am kind of imagining medium or medium-short hair with longer strands (sideburns? lol) framing the face. Furthermore, you could place a large bead (or something else?) on each sideburn to help gather and shape it (kinda like Touhou's Reimu). You could have her hair done up in the back in a more fancy chinese style, or it could be a somewhat tomboyish, shorter cut. What do you think sounds most fun? Snow leopards' eyes are grey, green, or blue. Perhaps a pale green or pale blue that brings out the secondary color in her hair. Although a pale grey color would bring out the color of her skin... I imagine she'd be sporty, athletic, and competitive. A tomboy, I guess? Although she'd also be the type to be flustered when she's treated as a girl... Also, Tibet is very Buddhist. Do you think a bindi would be too much? I'm starting to think a simple, shorter cut for her hair would help her to not be overdesigned, lol.

My general idea is to pair qi lolita and wa lolita together. Xuehua wears qi lolita clothes, and Shiori wears wa lolita clothes. Does that sound fun? If you're feeling ambitious, you could include some sanskrit embroidery on Xuehua's outfit. There are a few particular buddhist sayings (Lotus sutra: https://www.rigpawiki.org/index.php?title=Lotus_Sutra) that could be appropriate. Actually, lotus symbolism could be neat. Lots of ideas... feel free to separate the wheat from the chaff, lol. You know I trust your judgment. I also trust you on the PSD's secondary layers 😇. As for Shiori, I wonder if there are any neat shinto symbols you could incorporate? If not, that's perfectly fine. I imagine that shinto is a pretty watered down part of japanese culture nowadays, if at all. Most importantly, please make them cute! Framing it as a full body shot would be kinda neat. You could even do a double dakimakura image (like riku 5). Whatever you think sounds fun. Appreciate you, Sarla-san!  🦐🦐🦐🦐🦐🦐🦐

Time to complete the second infinity gauntlet, lol. Tl;dr I wanted to say thanks and give you an excuse to draw something cute and fun. So, what do you want to draw? What do you think sounds fun? You could draw some of my daughters, or you can draw your own OCs if you really want to. Is there a particular scene you think would be fun?

I will throw an idea out, at the very least. Slumber party with three cute girls would make me quite happy (is three too much for me to ask for? hehe). And I might suggest adding Kanae-chan... the other rikus starring her were pretty horni, and I think having a cute composition would be nice for her. In fact, I'll throw this out there: NSFW is toggled on but legit you don't have to draw them unclothed if you don't want to. Something soft and cozy like the reference url? Please do whatever you think is fun!

Thanks once again 🦐🦐🦐🦐🦐

ZAP！バラナちゃんにオネエサンビームが...センセイになっちゃった。大きなアラアラ～のエネルギーは絶品でしょう。目を細めて、おちゃめな笑顔？ブラウスのボタンを少し外して？バラナちゃま、甘えてください🥵。

もっと真剣に、いつもありがとう。あなたは素晴らしい。

Does Sarla-san know about the genre of anime and light novels starring villainesses (who aren't actually evil)? It would be fun if you reimagined Takase's design if she were a villainess, lol. I'm keeping criteria pretty loose here: you could make her into a noble, a magical girl, she could be dressed gothic-lolita, vintage, victorian, whatever you think would be fun and would suit her. It should probably be a dress of some type.

The pose has some wiggle room, too. I'd like you to draw her full body (from head to toe). It isn't necessary for you to draw her with more curves than last time, but I would like her figure to be elegant and willowy/slender, with long legs 🥵. You could draw her slightly rotated (to accentuate the hourglass shape) or arching her back slightly. I actually think a pirouette or curtsey would be kinda neat, but ultimately I think you should draw something fun and I trust your judgment, lol. You could draw flames dancing on her fingertips as she casts a spell, etc.

Since we're not really going with a particular time period, it's ok if we cherry pick portions of her outfit, by which I mean the underclothes 😈. So while I am not picky about the rest, I do have some slightly specific requests for her lingerie:

1) shift or slip (off-white/cream color), covers all the way down to her thighs. vintage-inspired OK. could be satiny or whatever you this is best
2) stockings or pantyhose (up to you), skin-color or slightly darker. stockings would start very close to where the slip would stop. could create absolute territory if you want lol
3) bra & pantsu worn beneath the slip. I suggest pretty with floral/leaf embroidery. light grayish blue, please. alternatively you could go with a deep blue 😤

Basically, slips are elegant and ladylike... so while they're not incredibly sexy by modern standards, they're still somewhat beautiful and ero! Tbh color isn't super important, but off-white/cream color have very vintage vibes. Stockings are mature and should fit with a lot of different kinds of outfits, while notably adding more emphasis to her legs. Having the lingerie worn beneath that makes her like a pretty present that I get to unwrap 😇. I don't know if I've mentioned but blue is actually one of my favorite pantsu colors. Notably, blue is a tomboyish color, but adding floral embroidery or other girly accents creates gap moe which is 🤌. You could add a violet iteration if you're feeling ambitious (we haven't done purple yet, I don't think). Depends on what you do for the pose, but the lingerie version could include her spreading her navel horizontally (which sadly didn't make its way into the last riku lol).

Hairstyle and expression are up to you. I am actually somewhat curious to see what Takase would look like with her hair down. However, you should pick something fun and suitable for a faux villainess. Surprise me!

Thanks for all you do, it's appreciated.

Happy early Valentine's!

I have another riku for you, once you finish your current project. Does Sarla-san like drawing 和服? Perhaps you could design two cute girls this time. 😌 I'll share ideas for the girls and their designs, then ideas for the composition.

Sunaho (恵) or Ayano (恵乃). Do you have a preference on her name? I think cervid (deer-like) or caprid (goat-like) features would be very pretty. I especially think antlers would look very majestic. You could give her slightly caprid pupils (perhaps cross-shaped instead of ovals, kind of like Nia Teppelin from Gurren Lagann ❤️). She should have light brown hair, almost a golden brown or fawn color. Please do not make her blonde, though. Light brown gives a very gentle impression, which should suit her sweet and mature personality quite well.

Takase (貴世): Perhaps Sarla-san could draw Takase as a dragon girl. Do you have a preference between eastern and western dragons? The truth is, I really like eastern dragons, especially when they have fluffy tails. But does Sarla-san think it would be fun to design a western dragon? If so, my suggestion is to draw Sunaho/Ayano as an eastern dragon with antlers and slightly caprid eyes. Then you can make Takase into a western dragon (with scales and horns, etc). 😌 I imagine Takase could have a fiery red-orange hair, maybe even with tyrian purple ombre. I imagine she's a bit tsundere, as well as being arrogant.

和服: I like both kimonos and yukatas. Which do you like, and which is less headache to draw? One is incredibly elegant and the other is summery and fun. I leave that decision to you. I think they'll look pretty either way. A floral pattern would suit Sunaho/Ayano, but I'm not sure about Takase.

Composition: I'd like if you could draw them from head to toe. Please draw them holding hands like you did Barana and Nanoka in riku3. I am not incredibly particular about the other details of the pose, as long as they look pretty and majestic. I am hesitant to ask you to make them tall or lithe. I do think you could make them look supple and elegant, with slightly long legs. Does that make sense? Either way, I do have two ideas for EX pose.

First idea: you could draw the two daughters lifting the hem of their 和服 to display pretty pantsu. Takase's expression should be disgusted. The other daughter's expression should be disappointment.

Second idea: you could draw the two daughters without their wafuku, in lingerie much like riku3. Their expressions should be the same (disgust and disappointment). Which option do you think is best?

Hair: I think one daughter should have her hair worn in a japanese chignon, perhaps with a few loose curls framing her face. The other should wear her hair in a very long braid that hangs over her shoulder. Do you have a preference which style matches with which daughter? They'll both be lovely, so please surprise me! Perhaps you might put a small emphasis on one daughter's neck. Elegant napes can be very beautiful, after all. 😌

Please consider drawing them with colorful eye shadow (a bit like Azur Lane's Akagi). Red could look very nice, and the other daughter might look nice with a purple or umber color. Colored nails would be nice, too. In fact, a dragon girl might have long (and slightly sharp) nails. What do you think?

Lingerie: since they are pretty and elegant, I think it's ok if you drew something a bit more sexy than cute (as long as it still has elegant details). I actually think string pantsu like Barana wore in riku3 would work very well. The other daughter could wear something more full coverage. I do think that floral design would suit the deer girl. Other than that, I'm fairly certain you will do a good job. 😤 Pretty details, picot lace, and ribbon. I don't think I've asked you to draw light purple (violet) lingerie before. Perhaps that would be nice? Brown is a somewhat strange color, but what do you think of a grayish amaranth (https://www.perbang.dk/rgb/9F7579/)? It may go very well with umber eyeshadow. Please and thank you! I do have a preference for them wearing brassieres... however if you feel like being more accurate, I do think a sarashi or slip might be a fun addition to the psd. Do what you think is best.

Legwear: Again... if you want to be accurate, I imagine that tabi are suited to the outfit. Buuuuuuut the truth is thigh socks and pantyhose are both much better. 😇 Do whatever you think is best. If you do include pantyhose, then please include thigh bands as well as gusset. Beautiful details!

Links weren't working with skeb earlier, so instead of including links I added picture references. Hopefully that helps clarify things.

Last but not least, this is not a kisekae riku, so you really don't need to go above and beyond. If anything, please pick something beautiful, stick with it, and do your best!

Have I left anything out? I don't think I have... If the riku is NG then please cancel. Thanks for all you do, Sarla-san, you're a rockstar. 🦐🦐🦐

Sarla-san, would you mind making a kisekae of riku2 with Nanoka-chan? It's perhaps my favorite of the pieces you've drawn for me, but I really liked the kisekae aspect of riku6. In essence, I'd like you to have fun dressing her up and making her pretty, but I do have a few particulars I'd like to ask for. 🦐🦐🦐🦐

Hmm... the last riku with seifuku looked really good, but I'd like to see Sarla-san draw a cute jumper skirt, too. If possible, consider drawing Nanoka wearing a cute jumper skirt seifuku. It should be colored navy with a white undershirt. I am imagining a high waist with a box pleat on the skirt... however, if tweaking some minutiae makes it more fun for you then I trust your judgment. If at all possible, please consider including pretty off-white petticoats. They're very feminine and incredibly erotic! ❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️

If you don't mind adding a second outfit, I would very much like a slightly sheer nightgown. Being able to see a little bit of what is beneath the fabric is incredibly erotic. Long (down to her ankles or so) is fine, but do whatever is cute and fun. Girly details would definitely be fun, of course.

You can obviously reuse the majority of Nanoka and her pose from riku2. I would appreciate if you could add some detail to her feet (so they'll look good while bare) and adding a bit more to her arms, if necessary (so that she'll look fine without clothes, too). I actually think adding a few extra poses for her arms would be very neat... Having one with her arms stretched up above her head to show off her stomach and armpits would be lovely. It would also be fun to include a skirt lift, especially for the seifuku and nightgown.

The blue pantsu from riku2 were very good! If possible, consider adding a matching bra. I'd also very much enjoy if you could add another set of lingerie, too. Something orange or violet pastel, very girly and feminine would be quite nice. Picot lace and a bow, ofc, preferably more pretty or cute than sexy. If you're feeling very ambitious then you could include her green lingerie from the other riku as well. If that is too greedy of me to ask, then do whatever you think is fun. I continue to trust your judgment!

Legwear is ofc very important... please include the white tights from riku2. If possible, adding a darker color (tan/nude color, pretty please! or even both tan and black???) as well would be excellent. If possible, consider adding an option for thigh-highs and garter belt, too.

So, I realize I'm being a little bit greedy here... if it's too much, then you can ofc cancel. Long story short, please dress up Nanoka-chan and make her pretty! If you don't mind, then please collate (combine) them with the content from riku2 for a more comprehensive kisekae psd.

In summary the psd ought to have:

hoodie + unzipped hoodie
jumper skirt (with petticoats if possible)
nightgown (skip this one if necessary)

peace sign hands
heart hands
skirt lift
arms raised

blue lingerie
pink or violet girly lingerie
green lingerie (skip this one if necessary)

white tights + pulled down
tan tights + pulled down
black tights (potential skip)
thigh-highs + garter belt

If you've got questions you'd like me to clarify then feel free... If I'm asking for too much then we can figure out a more appropriate price, or reduce the amount that I'm asking for. Thanks for lending an ear, I appreciate it. You're a rockstar, Sarla-san! 🦐🦐🦐🦐

To complete the infinity gauntlet, I need another picture of Barana-chan. Please draw her wearing seifuku while reading a book. Her skirt is lifted while she is oblivious. I'll list a few ideas and you can pick whatever sounds most fun.

Outfit: you could draw a two-piece summer seifuku, or a cute navy jumper skirt. So... two-piece means you could lift the shirt as well as the skirt (for midriff & underboob, or bra). Jumper skirt, on the other hand, has a high waist (more to see beneath the skirt, including navel & midriff) but means no shirt lift. Jumper is probably better, but if you think you can make the other work then you're more than welcome. Whatever is fun.

Pose: if Barana's skirt is lifted while she reads, it probably means someone or something else is lifting her skirt. It could be a naughty male classmate, a bratty little boy, an animal (dog or deer fit the trope), a naughty girl classmate (Chako is obvious, but Nanoka would 100% do this to tease her friend Barana), or even a gust of wind. It's up to you what you feel like drawing. If you draw Chako or Nanoka, you could include them smugly lifting their own skirts, too. If you want to draw another character design (Barana's  classmate, sister, or cousin, etc), that's ok too. Please do whatever is fun. You can add differences for the expression or leave it oblivious, per your judgment.

I'd like a frontal view of her pantsu, preferably with her thighs together. Lift her skirt high enough to show off the pantsu entirely, as well as her thighs, stomach, and navel. You could draw her tail curling bashfully (or thoughtfully as she considers her book).

Pantsu style: I really like the two designs you drew for Nanoka, as well as the pantsu you drew for Kanae on the last pic. I'd like if you could draw something similar. Full coverage is great, especially when you can strike a balance between cute and pretty, with good detail. You could include sheets with differences again, if you're feeling ambitious. Either way, I would enjoy a yellow pastel color (if you'd like to post differences, then please surprise me!).

Location: she could be reading outside school while waiting for a friend, or on a train to/from school. There are a couple other places she might read while standing (vs sitting). A gust of wind could strike almost anywhere. I trust your judgment, so do what you think is best.

So... once again, a lot of half-baked ideas. I trust Sarla-san to make something beautiful from them, so feel free to exercise your judgment. Thanks again.

Bark bark & salutations again. Sarla-san, I want to ask if you'd draw something like you did with Barana-chan and Nanoka-chan. This time, please draw Chako-chan and Kanae-chan instead! Cat Kanae is fine if you prefer it. Otherwise let's have her be a fox.

I don't exactly have concrete ideas, so we can collaborate a bit like we did with the last picture. I'll bounce some ideas off of you, but ultimately I trust your judgment so please draw something fun and pretty that you want to draw 🦐🦐🦐🦐🦐

One idea is for you to draw the two of them lying down. They could each be arching their backs inward (similar pose to Nanoka1 pic, except mirrored/symmetrical). You could draw them wearing nightgowns or some other kind of sleepwear (pajama shirt? oversized hoodie? whatever is cute and pretty). I do like the idea of them (slightly) facing inward (like with the Barana & Nanoka pic), but again... slightly is the operative word. Frontal view of tummy & pantsu is still best <3

For the minutiae of the pose, I am quite flexible! You could draw something sleepy, pretty, and serene. I do think a joint hand heart would be cute, but as far as personalities go... Chako is mischievous and naughty, so it would be quite in-character for her to attack Kanae with a skirt lift. If you do that, then perhaps you could draw another sheet with Chako lifting her own skirt, too! Or you could draw iterations without the nightgowns entirely.

If you think that standing up is better for skirt lift attack, then that would be ok too. You could draw the two of them wearing seifuku, or with matching hoodies. They could be taking a cute selfie-type picture together. Or we could include Chako's dinosaur plush that has yet to make an appearance... and maybe he's lifting both of their skirts! High-waisted skirts are pretty, and could show off the navel... so many options.

For the pantsu... while お子様パンツ suits Chako very well, I would be happy if you had them both wearing something pretty (like with Barana and Nanoka). It can still be cute, since cute fit Chako and Kanae's personalities very well. You could add a version with spats for Chako if you'd like. Please do whatever is pretty and fun! Incidentally, I happen to love when artists post pictures with pantsu differences (even if it's just pattern and color, not the entire design that's changed). If you'd like to draw a few of those instead of focusing on pose differences, then that'd be more than ok. If pantsu are an expression of femininity, then the small minutiae of colors and patterns can make a big difference.

I trust your judgments on the expressions, but we definitely need at least one smug Chako face (or sticking out her tongue) and one upset Kanae. Feel free to have fun and surprise me. Best lingerie colors are pretty pastels. Add legwear if you'd like to... I do think that simple white socks suit Chako very well (they have an innocent, youthful connotation that contrasts her naughtiness well!). Could draw thigh socks instead of the bunched up ones) this time if you'd like. You know I also like pantyhose (if you drew them on Kanae, then make them skin-tone, which are slightly more mature and pretty). You could also draw Kanae without any legwear. Whatever you think is best!
